yeah i guess. its about my girlfriend honestly. we hit six months yesterday which doesnt sound like much but for me thats kind of a record lol

more of a lift i think. like she cooked this whole dinner and didnt make a big thing of it, just had it ready when i got home from work. i dont usually have someone do stuff like that for me

A little lift makes sense there, and the dinner sounds like it landed as being cared for without a fuss. I’m wondering if the good part was less the meal itself and more the quiet way she showed up for you?

huh. yeah ok thats actually it. its not the food. its that she pays attention. i mentioned like once weeks ago that work has been brutal and she just remembered and did something about it without me asking
That points to being seen, not just being fed. It sounds like the lift came from her remembering, and from not having to ask.
being seen. yeah. thats the thing i usually do the looking after in relationships and it goes the other way and then they leave. this is different and im trying not to overthink why it feels so good
